summary: The v47 shop drop reached the missing shk.c:sellobj path. The implementation scope covers its used-return dependencies, full active callers in drop, projectile, container, trap, and kick paths, plus the sounds.c shop chat route and its stock-price quote behavior.

source.branch: When an ordinary non-swallowed object is dropped on a costly spot in a shop whose keeper is present, C sellobj() computes its offer and handles the sale response; this recipe reaches the deliberate-sale query for a wished +5 dagger.
dependencies: src/shk.c:special_stock is the used-return dependency of sellobj and is included whole.
src/shk.c:dropped_container is the recursive ownership updater used by sellobj and is included whole.
src/shk.c:donate_gold is called by sellobj, check_shop_obj, and dokick.c:kick_object; it is included whole.
src/shk.c:price_quote is the active sounds.c:dochat stock-square path; it uses the existing get_cost(), contained_cost(), doname(), and currency() ports and is included whole.
src/shk.c:shk_embellish is a random, return-valued helper called by price_quote() and is included whole.
src/shknam.c:is_izchak is a return-valued dependency of special_stock and shk_chat; it is included whole with a source-pinned pure test.
src/dothrow.c:check_shop_obj is included whole and wired at all six active source call sites in throwit, thitmonst, gem_accept, and breakobj.
src/sounds.c:dochat calls shop_object/price_quote before requesting a direction when the hero stands on stock; otherwise its active domonnoise route reaches shk_chat. Both paths are wired.

callerAudit.sourceScopeDecision: The mismatch and complete source scope are claimed atomically. The scope includes sellobj(), special_stock(), dropped_container(), donate_gold(), price_quote(), shk_embellish(), shk_chat(), the pure is_izchak() helper, check_shop_obj(), and throw_gold(), plus source-aligned wiring at each active drop/pickup/trap/dothrow/sounds/dokick call site.
checkShopObjCallers: src/dothrow.c:throwit lines 1813 and 1836; both pass broken=FALSE
src/dothrow.c:thitmonst lines 2131 and 2222; they pass broken=FALSE and TRUE respectively

evidence: Saved queue entry at challenges/cases/v47/v47-drop-wished-dagger-to-sell-in-generated-shop-attempt7-pager-corrected-cfirst.session.json identifies the stop at segment 0, step 48, with 3 remaining screens; step 48 key `o` displays “You drop a dagger.--More--”, step 49 space displays the shopkeeper offer, and step 50 `y` records the sale.

The immutable recipe challenges/cases/v47/v47-drop-wished-dagger-to-sell-in-generated-shop-attempt7-pager-corrected-cfirst.recipe.session.json independently sets up a wizard, creates a shop, wishes a +5 dagger, then drops it and accepts the sale.

C source src/do.c:dropx (786-797) extracts inventory, checks shipping and altar effects, then calls dropy(); dropz (806-843) places the object and calls sellobj(obj, u.ux, u.uy) for shop levels before stackobj(). Before implementation, JavaScript preflight_dropx() rejected costly_spot() at :1956 before ordinary placement, and dropzAdmitted() recorded the shk.c:sellobj gap only inside its withImpact branch at :2205-2209.

C source src/shk.c:sellobj() (3927-4194) is a void shop-sale function with ordinary costly-spot eligibility, sale pricing, shopkeeper state, offer and confirmation branches, and payment/billing effects. At investigation start, js/shk.js had no sellobj() declaration; the implementation added it alongside existing costly_spot(), saleable(), set_cost(), record_price_quote(), and sellobj_state() helpers.

The complete direct-caller scan `rg -n 'check_shop_obj\(' nethack-c/upstream/src/dothrow.c` found six active call sites: throwit at 1813 and 1836, thitmonst at 2131 and 2222, gem_accept at 2372, and breakobj at 2545.
Fresh C/JavaScript differential for the corrected v47 recipe matched all 51 recorded steps, screens, cursor states, and random calls after the seller implementation.

The independently generated bookstore recipe recipes/sounds.c/shk-chat-bookstore-keeper-chat.session.json has a matching C recording in recordings/sounds.c/shk-chat-bookstore-keeper-chat.session.json. Its step 19 enters sounds.c:dochat, then step 20 reaches shk.c:shk_chat through domonnoise and prints the keeper bill for 120 zorkmids.

The separate recipe recipes/sounds.c/shk-price-quote-generated-bookstore.session.json and recording recordings/sounds.c/shk-price-quote-generated-bookstore.session.json match fresh C. Step 12 quotes the single paperback book, draws rn2(3) in shk.c:shk_embellish, and prints the price line.

The independent recording recordings/dothrow.c/throw-worthless-shop-object.session.json reaches the zero-offer sellobj path through throwit -> check_shop_obj; step 49 prints “Cahersiveen seems uninterested,” after special_stock returns FALSE.
The independent recording recordings/dothrow.c/throw-gold-generated-bookstore-probe.session.json reaches dothrow.c:throw_gold -> sellobj -> donate_gold; step 34 confirms 100 zorkmids of credit.
The independent recording recordings/shk.c/sell-large-box-contents-generated-shop.session.json reaches do.c:dropz -> sellobj -> dropped_container; step 39 confirms the contents sale.

The independent recording recordings/pickup.c/floor-shop-container-put-probe.session.json reaches pickup.c:in_container -> sellobj during a costly floor-container insertion; step 49 confirms the put-in action.

The independent recording recordings/sounds.c/shk-price-quote-generated-bookstore.session.json reaches dochat -> shop_object -> price_quote -> shk_embellish; step 12 quotes the paperback book. recordings/sounds.c/shk-chat-bookstore-keeper-chat.session.json reaches dochat -> domonnoise(MS_SELL) -> shk_chat at step 20.
